

`internal/model/review.go`: the shapes listed under Interfaces, stdlib
only, wire field names. `internal/review/rules.go`: three pure functions,
no DB, no HTTP.

```go
// OpenQuestion reports whether any question thread is still open, the
// condition under which an author round is refused (WL-REQ-1774).
func OpenQuestion(threads []model.ReviewThread) bool

// BlocksApproval reports whether any change_request thread is open. A note
// or question never blocks (WL-REQ-1777).
func BlocksApproval(threads []model.ReviewThread) bool

// State derives reviews.state from the roster and the rounds cast at the
// current base_ref. Rounds at an older base_ref do not count (WL-REQ-1777).
func State(roster []string, rounds []model.ReviewRound, baseRef string, openChangeRequest bool) string
```

First test, table-driven over `State`:

```go
func TestState(t *testing.T) {
    round := func(actor, verdict, base string) model.ReviewRound {
        return model.ReviewRound{Actor: actor, Verdict: verdict, BaseRef: base}
    }
    cases := []struct {
        name   string
        roster []string
        rounds []model.ReviewRound
        base   string
        openCR bool
        want   string
    }{
        {"nobody sent", []string{"a", "b"}, nil, "3", false, "open"},
        {"one of two approved", []string{"a", "b"}, []model.ReviewRound{round("a", "approved", "3")}, "3", false, "open"},
        {"all approved", []string{"a", "b"}, []model.ReviewRound{round("a", "approved", "3"), round("b", "approved", "3")}, "3", false, "approved"},
        {"all approved but a change_request is open", []string{"a"}, []model.ReviewRound{round("a", "approved", "3")}, "3", true, "open"},
        {"any changes_requested wins", []string{"a", "b"}, []model.ReviewRound{round("a", "approved", "3"), round("b", "changes_requested", "3")}, "3", false, "changes_requested"},
        {"approval at an old base does not count", []string{"a"}, []model.ReviewRound{round("a", "approved", "2")}, "3", false, "open"},
        {"latest round per reviewer wins", []string{"a"}, []model.ReviewRound{round("a", "changes_requested", "3"), round("a", "approved", "3")}, "3", false, "approved"},
    }
    // ...
}
```

Also table-test `OpenQuestion` and `BlocksApproval` (open, resolved,
obsolete, times three intents).
